title: The stickers, v
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Friday. One sticker survived: the one on the nose, peeled off and stuck to the corkboard by the pup's own face-rubbing, upside down. It stays there. The strip lets the figure onto the board, inverted.

panels.composition: The corkboard. WOOD looking at it, close, at something low down. BARNABY II rubbing his face on the board's bottom edge.

characters.pose: rubbing his face on the board

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man peering closely at the bottom of a crowded corkboard while a small three-legged dog rubs its face against the board's lower edge

panels.composition: The sticker. The helicopter figure, stuck to the cork by nose-transfer, upside down, rotor pointing at the floor.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a single glossy stick-figure sticker with a rotor on its head stuck upside down to a corkboard's lower edge

panels.composition: Wood's hand reaching to peel it. Stopping. The dog looking up at him.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man's hand stopping just short of peeling a sticker off a corkboard while a small dog looks up at him, no words

panels.composition: The corkboard, whole: twenty-two years of pins, and at the bottom corner, below the 1998 yearbook photo, one stick figure, upside down, staying. Wood back at the table.
props: the sticker, upside down, below the photo

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a crowded corkboard with decades of pinned papers and one small upside-down sticker of a stick figure at the very bottom corner beneath a yearbook photo, a man drawing at a table nearby, no words
image.notes: The sticker joins the corkboard inventory (objects.md): below the Pulitzer photo, inverted, Nov 2019.

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: The figure on the board at last, upside down, below the Pulitzer.
